items.label: DRILLER
items.why: the BASIC program the tape starts with. Lines 10 to 30 clear memory above 32767, load the next file at $FE40 and call it. Lines 40 to 80 are never reached: they are the lines that saved this tape's first two files (SAVE "DRILLER" LINE 10, SAVE "load" CODE 32768,448), and the last loads a file called mast0, which is not on the tape

items.label: load
items.why: the tape loader, 448 bytes run at $FE40: it decrypts itself with the refresh register, reads blocks 6 to 8 at a speed of its own and jumps to the game at $97A4 (orientation.md, "The loader, in a paragraph")

items.label: block 6
items.why: the loading picture, a screen of 6,912 bytes that reads DRILLER introducing FREESCAPE, which the Graphics tab draws at the tape's pace. No listing holds it because block 8, the game's own screen, is at $4000 by the time the game starts
